items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Willie Jackson used to dance, and he had a big tall Negro playing piano with him.

ctx.x: I don't know. They had a big pavilion out there. They had a big pavilion out there that used to serve soft drinks. Willie Jackson? Willie Jackson and a big tall Negro. Willie Jackson used to dance, and he had a big tall Negro playing piano with him.
I know Steve Lewis played with him for a while. It's a bracket.
